text:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: INC-2026: Spike in SSE latencies and connection churn in us-west-2 reported by synthetic checks. Error rate for streaming responses up from 0.7% -> 8% in last 10m.

emma: I'm on it, paging eng-oncall. tagging raj and sasha for runtime and routing.

raj: seeing 5xx spikes on sse-proxy 2/3 hosts, CPU at 95% on the hot pod pool. connections piling up in mux.

sasha: logs show continuous-batch queues backing up and KV cache thrash for long-context requests. likely tail latencies from large-chat sessions.

miguel: can we flip the streaming feature flag to force-polling for non-enterprise customers while we triage? lower blast radius.

emma: propose plan: 1) enable routing rate cap for streaming requests from free/paid standard tiers 2) flip streaming->polling for non-SLA customers via feature-flag 3) add temporary quota bump for enterprise so they don't fallback to heavy polling.

raj: agreed. I'm prepping a feature-flag rollout. patch: 
```bash
# feature flag toggle 
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  https://controlplane.redwood.internal/flags/streaming-mode \
  -d '{"value":"polling-for-tier:standard,free"}'
```

sasha: infra-bot, can you nudge the sse-proxy autoscaler to add 2 replicas in us-west-2 as stopgap?

infra-bot: autoscaler triggered: scaling sse-proxy-usw2 from 3 -> 5 replicas. expected stabilization ~90s.

support: should we run a status page message or wait until rollback window? customers are starting to DM support.

emma: minor customer impact now, but likely C-level in 20m if latency persists. post a short advisory: temporary mitigation in progress, some streaming responses may be delayed; we will follow up. Miguel - can you draft?

miguel: drafted msg: "We are applying a temporary mitigation to reduce streaming latencies in US-West. Some streaming responses for non-enterprise customers will be delivered via short-polling while we stabilize. No data loss. Expect improved latency within minutes."

emma: LGTM. support, post and link status page. add contact routing for enterprise customers.

support: posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026 - short advisory live.

raj: flag toggle applied to 9:47:32 UTC. verifying traffic: streaming connections down ~60% for standard/free, polling requests up. SSE error rate dropping.

sasha: also enabled a temporary token-level rate limit on streaming route: 10 RPS -> 5 RPS for tier=standard,free. config: 
```json
{"route":"/v1/stream","limit":5,"scope":"tier:standard,free","duration":"60s"}
```

raj: monitoring lat p95: dropped from 850ms -> 220ms within 2m. CPU stabilized to 60-70% on hot pods. mux queues cleared.

emma: good. keep the mitigations for 30m while we finish root cause. owners: raj for runtime, sasha for routing, miguel for comms.

sasha: starting a canary rollout for kernel selection fallback that might address KV thrash — will coordinate with raj before unpause streaming.

miguel: support reported 3 customers PM'd asking if this affects SLA — replied with enterprise note and dedicated support routing.

infra-bot: cooldown complete. sse-proxy replicas at 5, all healthy.

emma: I'll update the incident channel every 15m. if error rate stays <1% for 20m, we start staged re-enable: revert rate caps then switch streaming back for a small percent of standard traffic.

raj: adding a short-term grafana panel to the incident dashboard for streaming error rate and mux queue length.

sasha: rolling back feature-flag on a 2% canary at 10:25 UTC if signals good.

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by oncall. pager handoff scheduled in 45m. :white_check_mark:
